name: attention
notes: LOOKS LIKE: the arm lifts sharply out of rest (joint3 +35), pitches the forearm forward, then NODS — dips and rises on joint3/joint4 — and gives one clamp of the jaws before settling. The nod is what reads as 'I want you' without the base turning. Peak 14 deg/s. JOINT1 IS ZERO IN EVERY WAYPOINT. Operator instruction at the arm: there are clamps on the sides of the base, so the base does not turn — the collision model cannot see those clamps, so the person standing there is the authority. hw_backend refuses any stream moving joint1 more than 2 deg. All expressiveness is joint2-joint6 plus the jaws. Positions are OFFSETS from whatever pose the arm is resting in. Full-range revision, authorized 2026-08-30 ('i want you to fully use the arm not just slightly move it'); budgets are measured with arm/measure_range.py and every stream is MuJoCo self-collision-verified before a frame is sent.
